value.purpose: The single most important content in a card — intention text, alert title, empty-state title.

label.purpose: Section titles and field labels, uppercase micro-tracking.

shadows.name: press-active
shadows.purpose: Confirms the currently-selected segment in a toggle/score control. The only shadow in the system; never used at rest.

motion.name: scale-press
motion.purpose: Universal press feedback on buttons and segmented-control options.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width save/confirm action. Gold fill, black text, scales down and lightens on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 17px; background: #C9A84C; color: #0A0A0A; border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 54px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #E2C97E; transform: scale(0.97); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A84C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary button. Transparent with muted hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: none; border: 1px solid #2A2520; color: #9A9590; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:active { border-color: #C9A84C; color: #C9A84C; }

components.name: Segmented Control (Toggle)
components.description: Yes/No/N.v.t. three-way segmented control — the app's most-used interactive pattern.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; gap: 0; background: #1A1A1A; border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px; } .ds-toggle-btn { flex: 1; padding: 10px 4px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #9A9590; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 0.18s; } .ds-toggle-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-toggle-btn.active-yes { background: #242424; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #27AE60; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard text input. Surface-2 background, brightens border to gold on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #242424; border-radius: 10px; color: #F0EDE8; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; padding: 13px 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A84C; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content container. Flat, no shadow, hairline border.

components.name: Emphasis Card
components.description: Tinted-gradient variant for content that needs to stand out (dashboard, alerts, goal banners). Never a flat lighter gray.
components.css: .ds-card-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0E0C06, #080600); border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.25); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed frosted-glass tab bar replacing page navigation. Active tab is gold.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(10,10,10,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.12); display: flex; } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; padding: 10px 4px; border: none; background: none; color: #9A9590; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; min-height: 56px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 0.18s; } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #C9A84C; }

narrative.overview:
No invented metaphor — the system is named for exactly what it is. This is a private, single-user tool used once or twice a day, styled to feel like a well-made first-party iOS app rather than a "wellness product." Near-black surfaces layered in steps, a single warm-gold accent used sparingly for what matters most (the current phase, the current answer, the primary action), and two quiet functional signal colors — never alarming, never celebratory — for the concrete yes/no and financial +/- states the app actually tracks.

Explicitly rejected: gamified habit-tracker energy — no streaks, badges, confetti, or progress-bar dopamine hits. This is a therapy-adjacent tool, not a game.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black base (#0A0A0A) layered in three surface steps, never a flat gray
Gold is the only decorative accent; success/danger exist purely as quiet functional signals, not decoration
Flat by default; shadows appear only as feedback on an active press, never at rest
iOS-native interaction language throughout: segmented controls, safe-area insets, backdrop-blur nav, scale-down press feedback
System font stack, not a custom typeface — reinforces the "feels native, not branded" goal

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only color used decoratively. Green and red exist solely to report a concrete state the data already contains — never introduce them as UI decoration or a third accent.

rules.name: The Tinted Emphasis Rule
rules.body: A card that needs to feel more important doesn't get a brighter neutral — it gets a near-black gradient tinted toward its accent color instead. Depth and importance are communicated through color temperature, not lightness.

rules.name: The Press-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is never decorative and never present at rest. It exists only to confirm a segmented-control option is currently selected.

dos: Do keep gold exclusive to decoration/identity and green/red exclusive to reporting real data state.
Do build new emphasis surfaces with the tinted-gradient pattern, never a flat lighter gray.
Do reuse the toggle-row/score-row segmented-control pattern for any new multi-choice input.
Do respect safe-area insets on any new fixed-position element.
Do keep shadows exclusive to active/pressed segmented-control states.
donts: Don't add streaks, badges, confetti, gamification, or celebratory UI of any kind.
Don't add a third decorative accent color.
Don't use a custom typeface — the system font stack is intentional.
Don't fabricate testimonials, ratings, or social proof of any kind.
